newsitem.title: INDIA: India Konkan Rail to raise 1.5 bln rupees in bonds.
newsitem.headline: India Konkan Rail to raise 1.5 bln rupees in bonds.

text.p: The state-run Konkan Railway Corporation Ltd plans to raise 1.5 billion rupees through a domestic issue of tax-free bonds in November, its chairman and managing director said on Tuesday.
Konkan Railway chairman E.Sreedharan said the firm had so far raised 14.93 billion rupees through 10.5 percent tax-free bonds. The new bond issue would be at the same rate, he told a news conference.
Sreedharan said the firm had just raised a $70 million syndicated loan with an eight-year maturity at 130 basis points above the six-month London Inter-Bank Offered Rate.

"This will go a long way in enabling the corporation to complete the final phase of the Konkan railway project," he said. The company is building a 760 km long rail line which runs parallel to India's west coast.
Konkan Railway Corporation Ltd has been set up by the Indian Railways and the four beneficiary states - Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka and Kerala.
